_doc: packs/mixins/economy.py: the variable docs it registers (the model reads them each turn)
doc_stock: stock of {good} in {town} (changed by trade, production / consumption and caravans; do not set it directly)
op_trade: the player buys / sells in a town market (trade grain 3; negative qty sells at 85 %)
op_new_caravan: world rule: a caravan sets out when the price gap is wide enough (the engine does it; do not write this op in the narration)
op_haul: world rule: a caravan travels one leg
op_rob: world rule: a caravan is robbed
market_line: This world has a real market: prices move with stock and rumour, and caravans carry goods from town to town. Use the trade op when someone buys or sells; the going rate is the variable table's price.* / stock.* — never invent a price.
rf_not_at_market: you are not in a town with a market
rf_no_money: not enough money: {need} copper needed, you have {have}
